chunks: And it has been narrated in another report:
"The area between its two lava plains is what lies between al-Sawrayn and al-Thaniyyah."

key_terms.آخَرَ: another, indicating a different transmitted report
key_terms.الثَّنِيَّةِ: al-Thaniyyah, a named pass or landmark marking the extent
key_terms.الصَّوْرَيْنِ: al-Sawrayn, a named landmark marking one boundary
key_terms.لَابَتَيْهَا: its two lava plains, referring to the two volcanic tracts of al-Madīnah

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the boundary of the sacred area of al-Madīnah?
ai.summary: This report describes the sacred boundary of al-Madīnah by identifying the area between its two lava plains and specifying its extent through known landmarks. Its significance lies in defining the geographic scope of the sanctuary and virtue of al-Madīnah in hadith literature.
